name: ERP for a facilities and hospitality group
clientType: Facilities management and hospitality group (client under NDA)
summary: A custom ERP that runs procurement, inventory, projects, HR, payroll and finance for a facilities management and hospitality group.
challenge: The group ran facilities management, catering and hospitality across many sites, with requisitions, purchasing, vendors, inventory, projects, HR and finance kept in separate spreadsheets and tools.
solution: We built one ERP on a single database covering every part of the business, with role-based access, approval workflows, document attachments, notifications and a full audit trail in every module.

features.title: Procurement
features.text: Requisitions, purchase orders, vendor management, sourcing and RFQs with multi-step approvals.

features.title: Inventory and projects

name: Logistics ERP for freight, warehousing and customs
platform: Web ERP with client tracking links
summary: One system that runs sea freight, warehousing, trucking and customs clearance, from quote to delivery.
challenge: The company handled sea freight, warehousing, in-country trucking and customs clearance, but each service ran on its own tools and spreadsheets. One shipment touched four systems, and customers had no clear view of their cargo.
solution: We built a single ERP with a shared shipment timeline: freight bookings and container tracking, warehouse inbound and outbound with bin locations, fleet dispatch, and customs documents with HS codes and duty calculation, plus live tracking links for customers.

features.title: Sea freight
features.text: Bookings, container tracking and a shared timeline for every shipment.

features.title: Warehousing

features.title: Trucking
features.text: Fleet dispatch and trucking jobs for in-country delivery.

features.title: Customs clearance
features.text: Entries, documents, HS codes and duty calculation.

scope: Freight, warehouse, trucking and customs modules

name: Point of sale with one inventory across store, website and app
clientType: Fashion and sneaker retailer (client under NDA)
platform: In-store POS, web and app sync
summary: A custom point of sale that shares one live inventory with the retailer's website and mobile app.
challenge: The retailer sold limited stock through a website, an app and a physical store. Stock counts drifted between channels, items were oversold, and the in-store till could not see online stock.
solution: We built a POS on the same database as the website and app, synced in real time. It works with barcode scanners, thermal printers and cash drawers, and handles discounts, loyalty, card, cash, transfer and QR payments, and printed or emailed receipts.

features.title: Fast checkout
features.text: Scan, apply discounts and loyalty, take any payment method and print or email the receipt.

features.title: One inventory
features.text: Store, website and app share one live stock count.

features.title: Hardware integration
features.text: Barcode scanners, thermal receipt printers and cash drawers.

features.title: Sales dashboard
features.text: Daily revenue, top products and low-stock alerts for head office.

summary: A CRM for managing leads, with AI that writes outreach emails and sorts and drafts replies.

solution: We built a lead management CRM with a pipeline, email sequences and a shared inbox. AI writes personalised emails, sorts incoming replies by intent and drafts answers for the team to approve before sending.

features.title: Sequences
